categories.label: Company Overview
categories.content: Northstar Industrial Technologies (Northstar Industrial Technologies Ltd) is a UK B2B industrial technology SME founded in 2023. HQ Manchester with Bristol R&D and Austin US office. Company no. NST-UK-104882. VAT GB104882901.

categories.label: Operating Model
categories.content: Practice-led delivery across Cloud, Security, and Consulting with shared PMO, Finance, and Customer Success functions. Demo workspace content only.

categories.label: Governance
categories.content: Board meets quarterly. Audit and Remuneration committees active. Cap table held under Northstar Founders Trust and Midlands Growth Partners.
